formal_candidate.candidate_sha_source: the Step 11 formal commit SHA observed after commit and task-branch push

publication_sequence: run pre-publication Current, lifecycle, lineage, semantic, deterministic and scoped regression gates
push the Step 11 candidate task branch and verify its exact remote SHA
ordinary fast-forward formal refs/heads/main to the exact candidate SHA
fresh-fetch origin and create a clean main checkout
require expected candidate SHA == git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main == fresh checkout HEAD
run post-publication semantic validation on that fresh checkout
write the exact publication witness and result only to the 1111 receipt branch
forbidden_shortcuts: formal commit that embeds its own published claim
force push, history rewrite or squash

required_equalities: expected candidate SHA == remote refs/heads/main SHA
remote refs/heads/main SHA == fresh main checkout HEAD

claim_ceiling: This contract defines repository-local publication sequencing and witness boundaries only; it does not establish external truth, production readiness, Owner acceptance or epistemic acceptance.
